fire:
Rinse your mouth with warm salt water after every meal.
Do not smoke for at least three days.

Keep the wound clean and dry for the first week.
Change the dressing every morning.

Apply ice to the swollen cheek for ten minutes.
Take the painkiller only as directed.

Avoid hot drinks until the numbness wears off.
Eat soft foods for two days.

Brush gently around the stitches with a soft brush.
Call the clinic if bleeding returns.

Drink plenty of water during the recovery period.
Rest with your head raised at night.

Do not spit or use a straw on the first day.
The clot needs time to form.

Wash your hands before touching the bandage.
Report any redness or swelling.
quiet: Rinse your mouth with warm salt water after every meal, and do not smoke for at least three days.
Keep the wound clean and dry for the first week, changing the dressing every morning.
Apply ice to the swollen cheek for ten minutes and take the painkiller only as directed.
Avoid hot drinks until the numbness wears off and eat soft foods for two days.
Brush gently around the stitches with a soft brush; call the clinic if bleeding returns.
Drink plenty of water during the recovery period and rest with your head raised at night.
Do not spit or use a straw on the first day, because the clot needs time to form.
Wash your hands before touching the bandage and report any redness or swelling.
